title: Portal Guardian
description: A armored warrior with a determined expression stands within a swirling blue and green energy portal, holding a large futuristic rifle. A glowing green alien with red eyes emerges from the vortex beside him while dark tentacles writhe around the portal's edge.
prompt: A battle-hardened warrior in detailed tactical armor and cloak stands inside a massive swirling blue and green energy portal, holding a large sci-fi rifle. A luminous green alien head with glowing red eyes emerges from the vortex beside him. Dark tentacles curl around the portal's edge. In the background, a dark fantasy landscape with ancient East Asian pagodas on rocky mountains under a blood-red moon and smaller red planets in a starry night sky.
